sections.title: Mode
sections.description: Container mode: one shared global container, or one container per project.

sections.title: Mounts
sections.description: How ~/.claude and ~/.codex reach the container: bind mount a host dir, or use a volume.

sections.title: Workspaces
sections.description: Project directories mounted 1:1 read-write; defines the codex guard scope roots.

sections.title: Python venv
sections.description: Python venv source: none (only python3 in image), a read-only host mount, or a volume.

sections.title: GPU
sections.description: Enable GPU support via CDI; checks for nvidia-ctk and the CDI spec on the host.

sections.title: Egress
sections.description: Network egress policy: off, allowlist, or blocklist of domains; applied after login.

sections.title: Container network access
sections.description: Reach Docker networks through Dante SOCKS; optional host-side exec bridge runs tests only in containers on explicit scope=list networks and never mounts docker.sock into cbox.

sections.title: Host route
sections.description: Route container egress through a host-managed forward proxy so host /etc/hosts and host DNS resolution are honored; optional host-gateway alias maps host.docker.internal for direct host-side endpoints.

sections.title: SSH
sections.description: SSH access mode: none, forwarded host agent, container-generated keys, or both.

sections.title: Shell functions
sections.description: Install shell functions (~/.bashrc-cbox) plus a marker block in ~/.bashrc.

sections.title: MCP servers
sections.description: Select which MCP delegates from delegates.json are available in the container.

sections.title: Codex progress relay
sections.description: Wrap codex-* MCP servers in a shim that translates codex events into MCP progress notifications - codex output shows live in the Claude UI.

sections.title: Local model
sections.description: Off by default. A text-only MCP delegate (local-qwen) backed by a local OpenAI-compatible endpoint such as ollama - see etc/docs/LOCAL_MODEL_RUNBOOK.md.

sections.title: Hermes engine
sections.description: Off by default; third console engine (NousResearch Hermes Agent) installed at runtime into the shared bins volume; local OpenAI-compatible endpoint by default.

sections.title: Hermes MCP delegate
sections.description: Off by default. A zero-cost MCP delegate tool (hermes-local) that shells out to a one-shot hermes -z call per invocation, in an ephemeral per-call home isolated from the hermes console engine; requires the hermes console engine.

sections.title: Ollama (machine-scoped)
sections.description: Off by default. Machine-scoped infra service: ollama runs in its own owner compose project (cbox-infra-u<uid>), never inside a generated cbox project, so it survives per-project compose down. One value applies to every project on this machine; the isolated per-project wizard never asks about it.

sections.title: WireGuard (machine-scoped)
sections.description: Off by default. Machine-scoped WireGuard sidecar in the same owner project as ollama: server mode shares this machine ollama over one authenticated UDP port (no routing, no NAT, no IP forwarding - a single-service TCP forwarder only); client mode dials a remote peer and exposes it under a stable internal alias. One value applies to every project on this machine; the isolated per-project wizard never asks about it.

sections.title: Session-limit auto-resume
sections.description: Wrap interactive sessions in tmux and let a per-container watchdog type the resume prompt after a usage-limit window resets (isolated session scope + claude mount only).

sections.title: Agents
sections.description: Select which agents from etc/agents are installed; codex-* need their MCP server.

sections.title: Codex MCP
sections.description: Register claude as an MCP tool inside codex for reverse orchestration.

sections.title: Continuity
sections.description: Durable-continuity toggles: history, git changelog, diary, open questions.

sections.title: CLAUDE.md
sections.description: Deploy CLAUDE.md plus policies and templates; skipped when history is disabled.

sections.title: Settings
sections.description: Merge etc/claude/settings.merge.json into the effective ~/.claude/settings.json.

sections.title: Hooks
sections.description: Install hook scripts (codex guard, ask-claude MCP bridge) into ~/.claude/hooks.

sections.title: Git identity
sections.description: Mount the host ~/.gitconfig read-only into the container.

sections.title: APT packages
sections.description: Extra apt packages installed into the image at build time.

sections.title: Binaries
sections.description: Claude/codex version pins and the shared binary volumes; installs run host-side, runtime mounts are read-only.

sections.title: Restart policy
sections.description: Docker restart policy applied to the container.

sections.title: Engine autoupdate
sections.description: Host-side engine autoupdate for channel targets (claude stable/latest, codex latest, hermes latest): re-runs the vendor installer once the TTL elapses.

sections.title: DNS
sections.description: DNS resolution inside the container when egress is enabled: Docker embedded DNS, public resolvers, or a host-stable stub resolver IP.

sections.title: Clipboard image bridge
sections.description: Host clipboard image bridge over a unix socket answering Claude Code's Ctrl+V image paste inside the container.

dependency_text.dictate:hooks: auto-deploys the ask-claude hook when enabled
dependency_text.dictate:shim-hook: auto-deploys the codex_mcp_shim hook when enabled
dependency_text.dictate:continuity-hooks: history=1 auto-deploys the continuity hooks (commit log, ledger sweep, session digest)
dependency_text.disable:isolated-mode: disabled in isolated mode - container lifecycle managed per-project
dependency_text.disable:no-cdi: disabled until nvidia-ctk and /etc/cdi/nvidia.yaml are present
dependency_text.disable:hermes-off: disabled until the hermes console engine (CBOX_HERMES=on) is enabled
